faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor recruitment is 10 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology with an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology and have at least 2 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Counsellor position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Counsellor position at AIIMS Bathinda?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Counsellor post is between 21 years and 35 years. There is also a provision for age relaxation for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Counsellor post at AIIMS Bathinda as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Counsellor position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 56,100.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the AIIMS Bathinda Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 1180, SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 590, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Counsellor post at AIIMS Bathinda will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Counsellor position at AIIMS Bathinda is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the AIIMS Bathinda website or via the direct link provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Counsellor position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official AIIMS Bathinda website or the direct application link provided. Ensure all details are accurate and complete before submission.
